notes.title: Slaughter House Mode Unlocked
notes.content:
Hey All

I just released a patch unlocking Slaughter House without a need to go through Expedition mode. This is to address the issue raised in the first review. Generally speaking game have two modes:

- Expedition mode - this is hunt or be hunted experience, where the enemy will try to sneak on you and run into wilderness as soon as you notice his presence. 

- Slaughter house - this is survival mode which is similar to Dinosaur Hunt game.

I hope this will improve the experience for players expecting more of a Dinosaur Hunt type of game. 

Thank you for your purchase.

ANPA.US
